
# Set up

Import packages
```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  suppressWarnings({
  library(tidyverse)   # Data wrangling
  library(here)        # File management
  library(readxl)      # Read excel files
  })})
```

Set settings and universal variables
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = here())
```

Crosswalk between demand units' demand ID and delivery ID
Provided by Kristin via [this folder](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1BYFQlIA0JJ31sAHDt7yMovLWWZvwoMeO)

We want to clean up some text typos and filter out a few demand units that we decided to omit upon manual review
```{r}
crosswalk = read.csv("Inputs/Master M&I demand unit and delivery arc crosswalk May 18 2026.xlsx - All delivery arcs.csv",
                     na.strings = "")%>%
  rename(dwuc = 1, delivery_id_1 = 2)%>%
  select(-Notes)%>%
  mutate(dwuc = trimws(dwuc, "right"))%>%
  pivot_longer(!dwuc, names_to = "type", values_to = "delivery_id")%>%
  filter(!is.na(delivery_id))%>%
  select(-type)
```

Export
```{r}
write.csv(crosswalk, "Outputs/Crosswalk demand and delivery IDs/20260527_crosswalk_processed.csv", row.names = F)
```
